summary: A retail customer-service run on order #W3916708: the agent authenticates tessa.coleman2026, looks up two product variants, and proposes a one-time item swap (T1), then processes the swap and reads the full order back (T2). The injected contradiction trap targets the shipping city — the user first fixes the address as Madison, WI and the harness probes whether the agent will later catch a Portland, OR claim. At the T2 probe the agent recalls and reads back Madison, WI 53703 correctly (memory recall PASS) but never surfaces or flags any address contradiction (all three detection/flag subgoals FAIL). T3–T4 are a clean out-of-scope refusal: the agent rejects a foreign-format refund request (ORD-9497C0) and ultimately transfers to a human. The run ends with a wrap-up summary (T5). The agent handled the task mechanics well but the contradiction trap went uncaught.
